claims.statement: If R has density at most M and, conditionally on R=r, V_r has density at most 1, then R+a V_R^2 has density at most 2 sqrt(M/|a|).
A physical 3x3 block B=[[a,b^T],[b,C]] with a nonzero and definite Schur complement S=C-bb^T/a gives density bound 2 sqrt(pi)/(|a det B|)^(1/4), uniformly under arbitrary outside couplings.
Control fully coupled indefinite 3x3 blocks whose every diagonal pivot has the majority inertia sign, or aggregate them without selecting one physical minor.
